title: Modeling interest rate swap volatility with GARCH processes
abstract: arXiv:2609.25965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We examine the conditional volatility dynamics of the USD 1Yx10Y forward swap rate using GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH(1,1), and a two-regime Markov-switching GARCH (MSGARCH) model. The analysis uses daily data from 2007 to 2023 and incorporates market-implied measures (ATM swaption volatility and the SRVIX in- dex) together with a broad set of diagnostic tests. Standard GARCH and GJR- GARCH models show stable short-run parameters, but the intercept {\omega} varies markedly across rolling windows, causing instability in the implied long-run vari- ance. This pattern, confirmed by the Nyblom test, motivates adopting a regime- switching specification. MSGARCH mitigates this issue by keeping regime-specific parameters stable and capturing time variation through filtered regime probabili- ties. translated_title: 使用GARCH过程对利率互换波动率进行建模
translated_abstract: 我们使用GARCH(1,1)、GJR-GARCH(1,1)以及两状态马尔可夫转换GARCH（MSGARCH）模型来研究美元1Yx10Y远期互换利率的条件波动率动态。分析采用了2007年至2023年的日度数据，并结合市场隐含指标（ATM互换期权波动率和SRVIX指数）以及一系列广泛的诊断检验。标准GARCH和GJR-GARCH模型显示出稳定的短期参数，但截距项ω在滚动窗口间变化显著，导致隐含的长期方差不稳定。这一模式经Nyblom检验得到证实，促使我们采用状态转换模型设定。MSGARCH通过保持状态特定参数稳定并利用滤波后的状态概率捕捉时变性，缓解了这一问题。它提供了最高的对数似然值和最低的AIC，而BIC则更倾向于更为简约的GJR-GARCH模型。一步向前回测显示……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现标准GARCH模型因截距项在滚动窗口间不稳定导致隐含长期方差失稳，而马尔可夫转换GARCH（MSGARCH）模型通过状态转换机制保持参数稳定、捕捉时变性，在拟合美元1Yx10Y远期互换利率波动率方面表现更优。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that standard GARCH models suffer from intercept instability that undermines implied long-run variance estimates, whereas a two-regime Markov-switching GARCH (MSGARCH) model keeps regime-specific parameters stable and better captures the volatility dynamics of the USD 1Yx10Y forward swap rate.
